caveats: Two selected independent TRAIN cases of candidate17 do not establish a success rate or formal acceptance.
Case0 is a legal airborne strings attacking return over net; body-ground termination occurs at3s before any first landing is observed. No first landing or continuation is invented.
Case1 is a frame contact with qualified recovery, not an airborne strings or complete smash success.
50Hz native whole-body samples are replayed without interpolation; contact stills use exact native substep poses.
Case1 has no observed first landing either; its frame-only return never crosses legally, and only the robot recovery is qualified.
Original asset, motor limits, net/rules, outgoing>=8m/s,vz<=-1 and qualified0.8s recovery gates remain unchanged.
CPU llvmpipe rendering only; no model-generated actions or hardware validation.
